premise: T. rex stomps in the mud puddle to make the biggest ripples — THUMP, SPLASH — but only makes a muddy mess; tiny Dragonfly hovers and touches the water with the tip of her tail and makes the prettiest rings of all; T. rex claps, then tries the gentle way himself.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The North Wind and the Sun' told in a puddle: the gentlest touch makes the loveliest rings.
lesson: Gentle can work better than strong.

en-US.title: The Prettiest Ripples
en-US.text: {puddle:enter} {trex:enter} T. rex wanted to make ripples in the mud puddle. Big ones. The BIGGEST. {trex:go to puddle} {trex:face happy} He lifted one big foot {trex:live stomp} and, {sfx:splash} THUMP, SPLASH! {puddle:live splash} Mud flew everywhere. {trex:face surprised} Mud on his nose, mud on his tummy. The water sloshed and slopped, and then it went flat. No ripples at all. He tried again. THUMP, SPLOSH! {puddle:wobble} Slosh, slop. Flat again. {trex:face sad} [sighs] "I can't make any." {dragonfly:enter} Dragonfly came zipping by. {dragonfly:go to puddle} [curious] "Can I try?" She hung quite still above the water, her wings a blur. {dragonfly:live dip} Then she touched it with the very tip of her tail. {sfx:tip} Tip. {puddle:live ripple} One ring. Two rings. Three rings, spreading slowly, wider and wider, all across the puddle. [in awe] "Ooh," said T. rex. "The prettiest ripples ever!" {trex:face happy} {trex:live clap} He clapped his tiny arms, pat, pat, pat. {dragonfly:face happy} Then T. rex touched the water, very, very gently, with one toe. Tip. And a little ring spread out. {puddle:pulse} [happily] "Mine's small," he said. "But it's ROUND!"

es-ES.title: Las ondas más bonitas
es-ES.text: {puddle:enter} {trex:enter} T. rex quería hacer ondas en el charco de barro. Grandes. Las MÁS grandes. {trex:go to puddle} {trex:face happy} Levantó una patota {trex:live stomp} y… {sfx:splash} ¡PUM, CHOF! {puddle:live splash} El barro saltó por todas partes. {trex:face surprised} Barro en el hocico, barro en la barriga. El agua se agitó, chapoteó… y se quedó lisa. Ni una onda. Lo intentó otra vez. ¡PUM, CHOF! {puddle:wobble} Chap, chap. Lisa otra vez. {trex:face sad} [sighs] —No me sale ninguna. {dragonfly:enter} Libélula pasó zumbando. {dragonfly:go to puddle} [curious] —¿Puedo probar yo? Se quedó quietecita sobre el agua, con las alas zumbando. {dragonfly:live dip} Y lo tocó con la puntita de la cola. {sfx:tip} Tip. {puddle:live ripple} Una onda. Dos ondas. Tres ondas, abriéndose despacito, cada vez más grandes, por todo el charco. [in awe] —Oooh —dijo T. rex—. ¡Las ondas más bonitas del mundo! {trex:face happy} {trex:live clap} Aplaudió con sus bracitos, plas, plas, plas. {dragonfly:face happy} Luego T. rex tocó el agua, muy, muy suavecito, con un dedo del pie. Tip. Y salió una ondita. {puddle:pulse} [happily] —La mía es pequeña —dijo—. ¡Pero es REDONDA!

splash.prompt: a big foot stomping into a shallow mud puddle, a heavy thump and a messy wet splash, realistic

tip.prompt: a single tiny drop touching still water, a soft delicate plink, realistic, close
